Photon Interview Questions

Tell about yourself Diff between Junit and TestNG what are TestNG annotations? Find Duplicate Characters in string. Find reversal of string word by word. Selenium - Given this url “https://www.geico.com/" and asked to pass numbers to zipcode textbox and click go and validate the result “thanks message” diff between assert and verify Explain about locators in selenium. diff between explicit and implicit wait. what are types of testing? what is method overloading and overriding? How do you upload a file in selenium? How do you create a defect in jira tool? Experience on Rest API Explain about API response codes
